title: Convert plan generation from forced pre-turn LLM call into free mental agent verb (plan)

sections.what: Convert PlanManager.generate from an automatic pre-turn system LLM call into an explicit free mental agent action (`plan [intent]`), matching internal mental verbs (`recall`, `goal`, `obligation`, `schedule`) while preserving StructuredFormats.plan + PlanGrounding step validation.
sections.why: Currently static/js/agent-engine.ts (lines 1680-1691) unconditionally fires a separate PlanManager.generate LLM call before the turn loop whenever PlanTracker.shouldReplan returns a reason (including every 5 turns on plan expiry), even during casual conversation. Planning should be a character-initiated mental action costing 1 free slot rather than an out-of-band harness cron call, while preserving typed step grounding so plans do not regress to ungrounded prose.
sections.how:
1. Register VerbSpec("plan", aliases=("replan",), scope="internal", target_schema="target", cost_key="free") in engine/action_verbs.py and regenerate static/js/agent/action-verbs.generated.js.
2. Add a backend/route free-action handler in routes/action_handlers.py (and client execution hook in static/js/agent-engine.ts) so executing `plan` / `plan <intent>` spends 1 free turn slot, invokes PlanManager.generate(charName, intent) (preserving StructuredFormats.plan + PlanGrounding), updates PlanTracker.setPlan(...), and refreshes observeParts.plan for remaining action slots in the same turn.
3. Replace the forced pre-turn PlanManager.generate() call in static/js/agent-engine.ts (lines 1680-1691) with a prompt cue in === YOUR PLAN === when PlanTracker.shouldReplan(...) is truthy ("No active plan / plan interrupted - use free action `plan <intent>` to form a grounded multi-step plan, or act directly"), while keeping PlanTracker.seedFromPlayer() for server-authored active_pursuit.
4. Surface `plan` in contextual-actions.ts and PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and add JS unit tests verifying both mental-verb planning and zero forced pre-turn LLM calls.
sections.verify: Run python tools/action_verbs_index.py --check, npm run build:ts, node tools/unit/run.cjs (test_plan_manager, test_plan_tracker, test_plan_grounding, test_turn_prompts), and pytest tests/test_action_verbs.py.

acceptance.text: plan (alias replan) is registered in engine/action_verbs.py as scope="internal", target_schema="target", cost_key="free", and reflected in action-verbs.generated.js, PlanGrounding, and contextual-actions.ts.

AgentEngine.step no longer fires PlanManager.generate unconditionally before the turn loop; instead, === YOUR PLAN === cues the agent when no plan is active, a plan is blocked/expired, or a threat/critical need interrupts.

Executing plan / plan <intent> during a turn consumes 1 free mental slot, invokes PlanManager.generate(charName, intent) using StructuredFormats.plan + PlanGrounding, updates PlanTracker and observeParts.plan in-place for the remaining slots of that turn, and preserves server active_pursuit seeding.
JS unit tests verify mental-verb plan execution, grounding preservation, free-slot cost, and removal of the forced pre-turn LLM call.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Available Actions (free mental verbs) and === YOUR PLAN === prompt header in AgentEngine.

Current availability: PlanManager.generate runs unconditionally before the multi-action turn loop in static/js/agent-engine.ts whenever PlanTracker.shouldReplan returns a reason.

Manual verification steps:
1. Run an NPC turn with no active plan or an interrupted plan.
   - expected: AgentEngine does not fire an out-of-band PlanManager LLM call before DECIDE; === YOUR PLAN === cues the agent to invoke free mental action `plan <intent>` if it chooses to form a multi-step plan.
2. Have the agent execute `plan <intent>`.
   - expected: StructuredFormats.plan + PlanGrounding run, 1 free slot is spent, and observeParts.plan updates in-place for subsequent actions in the same turn.
